surface.briefText: Run gui-improve again on the General settings tab, this time for real: the task text must allow the implement and correct stages to write in public/ and lib/ and to commit on a branch, the compare stage must take its after shots at the same viewports and states the baseline recorded, the review gate must be free to reject with a note, and the change must land by PR with the comparison page showing before, after and diff for every pair, so the improvement is code on main rather than a ledger entry.
surface.change: each preset row must read as part of the control above it, and its pills must share one width
surface.changeSource: Carried from the first gui-improve run on this tab (worktree add-generic-gui-pipeline-to-bundle-4c4680). public/style.css:438-441 is still the unmodified style in this tree, so that run's change never landed.
surface.reproduce: The captured pixels are the served build's public/index.html, app.js and style.css (hashes in environment). To shoot the after state of an edit in this worktree, serve THIS worktree on a free port with its own PANEL_CONFIG (public/ is read per request; lib/ needs a restart) and follow the same steps at the same viewport. The 340x520 surfaceFile depends only on the public files, not on the live board behind the window.
surface.scope: The whole Settings window (#settings): its head, search box, tab strip and the visible General panel. Hidden tabs are not painted and are excluded.

environment.servedNote: public/index.html is rewritten by the panel for cache-busting (stylesheet links carry ?v=<panel-build> and a meta panel-build tag is added), so its hash differs from the tree by that stamp and nothing else; app.js and style.css are byte-identical.

states.name: open
steps: Fresh browser context at the viewport (no localStorage, so the settings window and tab are at their defaults).
wait for #btn-settings and for the first /api/state paint (2.5 s settle).
click #btn-settings to open the Settings window.
click #settings-tab-general (aria-selected=true on the General tab; #settings-panel-general not hidden).
set #settings .settings-body scrollTop to 0 and wait two animation frames for layout to settle.
assert #settings is visible, #settings-panel-general is the only visible [data-settings-group], and #settings-search is empty.

states.name: search
steps: Reach the open state exactly as above.
fill #settings-search with "budget" (the one General row that answers it: Turn briefing budget).
wait 900 ms for the filter to paint, then assert the General tab is still selected, the search badge reads 1, and only that row paints.
set #settings .settings-body scrollTop to 0 and wait two animation frames.

notes.instance: Captured against a throwaway second instance of THIS checkout (tools/panel-testkit.mjs startPanel): free port, own PANEL_CONFIG and own store under the scratch dir, assistant/gateway off. It serves public/app.js and public/style.css byte-identical to this tree (hashes in environment.servedFiles). The live panel on 7331 serves a different build and was not touched.
notes.board: The sandbox config carries no projects (projects: []), so the board behind the Settings window is empty. That is why shots[*].file (the full-page record) is not pixel-comparable with the baseline's full-page shot; the Settings window is, and its rect is recorded in shots[*].win so the compare stage can diff that region out of each full-page shot.
notes.shotPair: shots[*].file is a full-page record with the Settings window at its recorded win rect; shots[*].surfaceFile is the 340x520 Settings window alone and is the stable pair to diff. Every pair here has the same viewport, state, steps and asserts as its baseline counterpart.
notes.servedIndex: The served public/index.html differs from the tree only by the panel's cache-busting stamp (?v=<panel-build> on stylesheet links and a meta panel-build tag); app.js and style.css are byte-identical to this tree.
